results.name: Two source operators with equal characteristic polynomials versus a repeated target operator
results.interpretation: The exact characteristic-polynomial candidate graph has no perfect matching. Similarity of each paired linear part is necessary for affine conjugacy, so no affine map bijection exists.

joint_relational_trace_filter.profile_definition: For each map A_i, the sorted multiset over all A_j of the six exact trace words listed above. The multiset preserves map multiplicity but is invariant to map-label permutation.
joint_relational_trace_filter.logical_status: Necessary condition for one common simultaneous affine conjugacy; not a sufficient proof. Full affine equations and determinant remain decisive.

global_guard: Joint trace profiles are exact necessary invariants under a common simultaneous conjugacy. They only prune map pairings; every surviving candidate must still pass the complete affine equations and invertibility check.
